Netlist Announces Appointment of Noel Whitley as General Counsel and James Hickey to Board of Directors
items.sum: Netlist, Inc. (OTCQB: NLST), a leading innovator in advanced memory and storage solutions, today announced the appointment of Noel Whitley as General Counsel and James Hickey as an independent member of the Company's Board of Directors. Mr. Hickey's appointment is effective November 17, 2026, and he will serve on the Board's Compensation Committee and the Audit Committee.
